products.title: 2-Wire Braided Hydraulic Hose Assembly, JIC 37° Female Swivel × JIC 37° Female Swivel
products.focusKeyword: hydraulic hose assembly jic 37 female swivel x jic 37 female swivel
products.descriptionShort: 2-Wire Braided Hydraulic Hose Assembly, JIC 37° Female Swivel × JIC 37° Female Swivel. 5 hose sizes, 1/4" to 1" ID, in standard lengths of 12" to 300"; 80 part numbers in the size table.
products.descriptionLong:
The 2-Wire Braided Hydraulic Hose Assembly, JIC 37° Female Swivel × JIC 37° Female Swivel is a made-up hydraulic hose assembly: 2-wire steel braid hose with a crimped JIC 37° Female Swivel on one end and a JIC 37° Female Swivel on the other. It comes in 5 hose sizes (1/4" to 1" ID) and standard lengths from 12" to 300" (305 mm to 7620 mm). Indus also builds assemblies to any length and end combination; send the run and we will quote it.

Hose

  • Reinforcement: two high-tensile steel wire braids
  • Cover: synthetic rubber, abrasion, ozone and weather resistant; the manufacturer states it is MSHA certified
  • Temperature: −40 °F to +212 °F (−40 °C to +100 °C), +248 °F (+120 °C) maximum, as the manufacturer states

Pressure

The manufacturer's working pressure for the hose, by size:

Hose IDHose working pressure (psi)
1/4"6,525
3/8"5,583
1/2"5,010
3/4"4,350
1"3,270

An assembly is rated to the lower of the hose and its end connections.

Sizes

80 part numbers. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab gives both ends and the overall length, L, in millimetres, for every one.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the hose size, the two ends and the length. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
